extensions.name: bugs-music
extensions.description: Bugs Music metadata provider with accurate track and album details, artist catalogs, TOP100, all genre charts from Bugs genre home, Music PD albums, and URL imports. Multi-source ISRC matching across Deezer, Spotify, MusicBrainz, iTunes and YouTube Music with hangul romanization fallback, 260+ artist aliases, track-title alias bridging for translated English registration names (e.g. 이 별로부터 ↔ Unknown Planet) so hangul titles whose official English release name is a meaning translation still resolve, iTunes hangul-latin bridging with English-registration feedback re-search, artist-name variant search, romaja-title queries and romaja fallback naming for romanized download sources, album-level lookup, variant-ISRC retry, and duration-verified scoring, Bugs CONNECT-badge cleanup, and variant-title demotion (instrumental/karaoke candidates lose to canonical ones). Hands confirmed Deezer/Spotify track identifiers (deezer_id/spotify_id) to the app's download resolver so downloads resolve directly instead of falling back to name search.
